task_title: verify-node.sh auth probe fails open: 404/000/500 are WARN and VERIFY PASS; node-create.sh admits the node
task_criteria: Fix is present in the graded tree: scripts/verify-node.sh exits non-zero and prints a FAIL naming the measured status code when /api/system/stats answers anything other than 401, 302 or 403 (404, 000 and 500 all FAIL); the auth_gate leg fails closed when /api/status lacks auth_required true; scripts/node-create.sh exits 1 and prints NODE INCOMPLETE when the auth probe is inconclusive and prints NODE CREATED only when every auth leg passed; tests/selftest.sh carries stub-curl fixture sections asserting both directions (401 and 403 pass, 404, 000 and 500 fail with a named FAIL row) and the suite prints SELFTEST: PASS; docs/OPERATIONS.md and docs/THREAT-MODEL.md state the enforced behaviour.
